What is the patient's certificate number?
What is the date of service?
authentication.notes: Canada Life uses CDAnet carrier ID 000011. Electronic claims must be submitted within 90 days of service date — after that, paper only. Canada Life took over administration of the federal PDSP (Pensioners Dental Services Plan) from Sun Life on November 1, 2024. Make sure to distinguish between private employer plans and PDSP — they have different phone numbers and workflows.

steps.expected_prompt: Welcome to Canada Life. For English, press 1. Pour le français, faites le 2.
For dental provider services, press 1. For health provider services, press 2. For plan member inquiries, press 3.
Please enter your provider number followed by the pound key.
For claim status inquiries, press 1. For predetermination status, press 2. For eligibility verification, press 3. To speak with a representative, press 0.
Please enter the patient's policy number.
Please enter the patient's certificate number.
Please hold for the next available representative.

shortcuts.destination: Representative queue — fastest route to human

common_denial_reasons.description: Service not covered — not in benefit schedule
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Check plan benefit booklet for covered codes. Some plans exclude cosmetic, implants, or certain restorative procedures.
Patient has exhausted annual benefit limit. Bill patient directly for remaining balance.

common_denial_reasons.description: Frequency limitation — service submitted too soon
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Most plans allow 2 cleanings/year, bitewings 1/year, full-mouth series every 3-5 years. Verify dates of previous claims.
Canada Life requires predetermination for major services. Submit electronically via CDAnet or through portal.
Submit X-rays, perio charting, or clinical narrative via fax or portal. Include claim number on all submissions.

common_denial_reasons.description: Coordination of benefits — primary carrier has not paid
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Submit to primary plan first. Attach EOB showing primary payment amount before submitting to Canada Life.
Electronic claims must be submitted within 90 days of service. After that, submit paper claim to PO Box 3050 Station Main, Winnipeg MB R3C 0E6.

common_denial_reasons.description: Patient coverage not active on date of service
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Verify coverage effective dates. Patient may have changed employers or had a waiting period.

required_attachments: X-rays for crowns, bridges, root canals, implants
Clinical narrative for complex or unusual procedures
EOB from primary carrier for COB submissions

key_phrases: I'm calling from [Practice Name] regarding a Canada Life dental claim
The CDAnet carrier ID is 000011 and the patient's certificate number is [ID]
Can you confirm receipt of the claim and the current status?
What is the specific denial code and can it be appealed?
What documentation is needed and where should it be submitted?
Is there a deadline for submitting supporting documentation?
avoid_phrases: Great-West Life — Canada Life rebranded from Great-West Life in 2020, don't use the old name
London Life — also merged into Canada Life, separate references may confuse reps
PDSP provider line — use the private dental line 1-800-957-9777 for employer plans, not the PDSP line
escalation_triggers: Claim cannot be located after providing policy number, certificate number, and date of service
Denial code references PDSP or government plan on a private employer claim
Representative confirms payment was issued but practice has not received funds after 30+ days
Claim older than 90 days and rep says electronic resubmission is not possible
COB situation where Canada Life and another carrier are both claiming the other is primary
ai_agent_guidance.representative_script_hints: Canada Life reps are generally knowledgeable and have good system access. They merged with Great-West Life and London Life in 2020 — reps may still refer to legacy systems for older claims. For any claim predating 2020, be prepared for longer lookup times. If rep says the claim is 'with the adjudicator', ask for an estimated completion date — do not accept open-ended timelines.

metadata.notes: Canada Life is the result of the 2020 merger of Great-West Life, London Life, and Canada Life. They also took over the federal PDSP from Sun Life in November 2024. One of the largest carriers in Canada. For Tenth Line Family Dentistry in Orleans, Canada Life employer plans are very common given the large federal public sector workforce in the Ottawa area. The 90-day electronic submission window is a critical detail — claims beyond that require paper mail to Winnipeg.

change_log.reason: Major Canadian carrier — high volume expected
